_meta.description: Heating-season (October-April) averages of the 3CL C1 orientation coefficients for vertical glazing, per climate zone and orientation, plus simplified distant-mask shading factors (Fe2). The engine only uses the RATIOS between orientations to modulate the globally calibrated solar coefficient (deviation D-06): modifier = c1[orientation] / mean of the four orientations; the 'unknown' orientation maps to a modifier of 1.0 (balanced glazing).
_meta.source: Annexe 1 (méthode 3CL-DPE 2021) de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 modifié, version consolidée rt-re-batiment.developpement-durable.gouv.fr : coefficients C1 §18.5 (p.144-147, colonne inclinaison >= 75° (parois verticales), moyenne octobre->avril calculée); facteurs de masques lointains Fe2 §6.2.2.2.1 (p.50, obstacle d'environnement homogène).
_meta.notes: shading_factors: Fe2 averaged over facade orientations — obstacle 15-30°: S 0,8 / E-O 0,77 / N 0,82 -> 0,8 retained; obstacle 30-60°: S 0,3 / E-O 0,4 / N 0,5 -> 0,4 retained. 'clear_or_unknown' = 1.0: the calibrated D-06 coefficient already embeds an average masking level, so only explicitly declared masks reduce the gains. Hand check H1a south: (1,84+1,74+1,59+1,67+1,78+1,99+2,39)/7 = 1,857.
_meta.notes_cooling: c1_cooling_season_vertical (added 2026-07-11, #16 brique 2): June-September average of the VERTICAL (inclinaison >= 75 deg) C1 column per orientation, plus the single horizontal column, from the same 18.5 tables. c1_heating_season_vertical_mean: October-April average of the vertical column, averaged over the four orientations - used to rebase the calibrated winter solar coefficient (D-06) onto the official summer C1 level: sse_fr = aperture x 0.5 x c1_cooling[orientation] / c1_heating_season_vertical_mean[zone] x Fe2.
_meta.notes_correction: 2026-07-11: the table initially averaged the TILTED column (75deg > incl >= 25deg) of 18.5 by mistake (e.g. H1a south 1.857 instead of the vertical 1.000); replaced by the vertical (>= 75deg) column averages, correct for windows. Only the RATIOS between orientations feed the engine; the ADEME validation sample carries no glazing orientation (modifier = 1.0 everywhere), so the calibrated D-06 level and the published campaign metrics are unaffected (verified by re-running the v4 campaign bit-identical). The mean of the four vertical orientations per zone equals c1_heating_season_vertical_mean, used by the summer rebase.
